market_summary: During the London session, FX majors EURUSD and GBPUSD are consolidating tightly within their session Value Areas around POC/VWAP with sub-1.0 RVOL, lacking volume breakout triggers. BTCUSD remains structurally suppressed below session VWAP and EMA50 near its Value Area Low and local support levels, but lacks volume expansion to confirm trend breakdown continuation. All three assets warrant a HOLD stance.

signals.rationale: 1) VP: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10773 - VAH 1.10981) and trading slightly below POC 1.10946. 2) CVD is BULLISH (+3,833) with positive slope (+1,009.55), confirming recent upward drift. 3) Session is LONDON_SESSION. 4) Price remains above VWAP (1.10849) and EMA50 (1.10881), but upward momentum is moderating. 5) Mid-to-upper ATR channel position (upper band at 1.10972) suggests limited immediate upside without a range expansion. 6) RVOL is low at 0.727 with no yellow spike bars confirming a breakout. 7) Price failed to breach Session High at 1.10988 and is consolidating inside the Value Area right at POC. With GEX absent and no volume catalyst, a HOLD is prudent.
